methods.name: Ontology Alignment
methods.description: Studies how systems with different formal representations of their knowledge can communicate successfully by suggesting concept or instance alignments.

methods.name: Language Games
methods.description: An approach to establish successful communication in an open multi-agent system only via grounded communication.

methods.name: Interactive Reinforcement Learning
methods.description: Studies problems where the reward signal is sparse and incorporates human input to make convergence faster.

datasets.name: Ontology Alignment benchmark
datasets.description: An established ontology alignment benchmark modified for designing experiments for cooperative query answering.

metrics.name: precision
metrics.description: Used as a trade-off measure alongside efficiency for task achievement.

metrics.name: recall
metrics.description: Used as a trade-off measure alongside efficiency for task achievement.

metrics.name: number of interactions
metrics.description: Principal efficiency metric measured in terms of number of interactions or examples that agents exchange.

metrics.name: cognitive load
metrics.description: Example case-specific metric to evaluate shared understanding using the proposed framework.

metrics.name: memory demands
metrics.description: Measured in episodic memory and working memory sizes in number of memorized episodes and variables used respectively.

concepts.name: Open Multi-Agent Systems
concepts.description: A field where agents from a diverse population, that do not have an established communication protocol, need to learn how to communicate only via grounded interaction.

concepts.name: Cooperative Query Answering
concepts.description: A task where two agents need to collectively answer a query while representing different databases defined in their own ontologies.

concepts.name: Grounded Interaction
concepts.description: Communication via examples that consist of common instances for which agents are expected to have similar knowledge.

findings.name: Successful communication establishment
findings.description: Experiments demonstrate successful communication establishment under the required restrictions using only a very limited number of interactions.

findings.name: Robust query understanding performance
findings.description: A robust query understanding method can be expected to perform better in a scenario where the agents have incomplete knowledge of their environment.

findings.name: Informative examples interpretation
findings.description: Examples that seem to be more informative are more probable to be interpreted differently by the two agents.
